key_variables.brief_favorable_conditions: Not in the brief (replaces the lake-cichlid row, whose favorable condition was a positive water balance: rain > evaporation).
key_variables.why_these_variables: Water-balance proxies around the spring. Groundwater extraction, the documented cause, is not climatic.
key_variables.rainfall_caution: Reanalysis rainfall is the least reliable NASA POWER variable. Several sites show large multi-year shifts (e.g. Bramble Cay 2015–2025 about 42 % drier than 1981–2014; Monteverde dry-season rain about 3 times higher in 2009–2025 than in 1981–2008). A change-point test places these shifts in different years (1998–2015), so they do not point to a single data-source switch, but they may still be partly artificial. Rainfall forecasts that extend such shifts are uncertain: show the 80 % range and verify against local rain gauges before presenting them as fact.

survival_card.use_rule: Compare the same indicator, unit, annual aggregation and years. Values describe the historical regional grid cell, not measured physiological tolerances. A difference or an out-of-range value does not establish survival or death.
